name: Double-capitulation — crowd fear x implied-vol spike confirm (long spot)
rationale: CROSS-METRIC of two ORTHOGONAL fear gauges (fear_greed x dvol). fear_greed is a SURVEY/behavioral crowd-mood index; dvol is the OPTIONS market's PRICED implied-vol. A single fear read is noisy and famously slips into value traps (cheap-for-a-reason). Requiring BOTH to be at an extreme simultaneously — crowd sentiment at extreme fear AND options pricing a vol spike — is a meta-labeling-by-confirmation: two independent measurement systems agreeing the panic is real, which historically marks capitulation lows better than either alone. Mechanism before data: long spot when fear_greed is below a fitted extreme-fear floor AND dvol is above a fitted stress ceiling AND price has stopped freefalling (short ret guard); exit when fear_greed recovers through a neutral level. This is strictly distinct from fear-greed-contrarian-buy-extreme-fear (fear_greed + ret_Nd ONLY, no options-vol confirmation) — the dvol arm is the orthogonal second opinion that arm lacks. Disconfirmer 1: drop dvol — if fear_greed + ret guard alone matches the deflated Sharpe, the options confirmation adds nothing and this is the existing fear spec. Disconfirmer 2: the two gauges are correlated in crises; if the JOINT extreme fires so rarely that effective-N is below the gate floor, the confirmation buys robustness at the cost of tradability — the gate's min-trades will catch it. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): both daily next-day-available; net of ~20bps the bounce must clear. tier0 fear_greed + tier0 dvol, both fresh prod data, unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: extreme crowd fear (fear_greed low) CONFIRMED by an options implied-vol spike (dvol high) while price has stopped declining — a two-gauge capitulation, bought on spot
